title: Hot Work Permit to Work
subtitle: Permit HW 0142. Welding repair to a steel storage tank support, Vaal River Fabrication, Vanderbijlpark

rows: HW 0142 (from the numbered permit book; copy stays in the book)
Tuesday 12 May 2026, 08:00 to 16:00. Not valid after 16:00 or if conditions change
Bay 3, diesel storage tank support frame, Vanderbijlpark plant (fictitious)
Arc welding and grinding to repair a cracked support leg on the empty diesel storage tank frame
Johan van Wyk, Plant Engineer, authorised in writing to issue hot work permits
Permit receiver (person in charge of the work)

bullets: Fire or explosion from diesel vapour or residue near the tank
Sparks and hot slag reaching combustible material
Arc flash, fumes and hot surfaces
Electrical shock from the welding set

rows: Tank drained, fill and outlet valves closed, locked and tagged (lock numbers VRF 21 and VRF 22)
Transfer pump electrically isolated at the board, locked and tagged (lock VRF 23); start tested and failed to start
Combustible material removed from the work area; drains and openings covered with fire blankets
Welding screens erected; area barricaded and hot work signs posted
Welding set, cables and earth clamp inspected; register entry current (Section F)
Two 9 kg dry chemical powder extinguishers and a charged hose reel at the work area

blocks.p: Required, because the work is next to a tank that held diesel. Tested with a calibrated flammable gas detector (calibration record on file) at the tank openings, under the frame and at the drains.

**Fire watch:** Mpho Molefe, trained in the use of the extinguishers, stayed at the work area for the whole job with no other duties, and remained after the work stopped for the period the issuer wrote on the permit. Fire watch started 08:00 and ended 15:40 after a final check found no smouldering or hot spots.
Welding helmet with the correct filter, leather gloves, apron and spats, safety boots, flame resistant overalls, hearing protection while grinding, and local fume extraction at the weld.
I have explained the hazards and controls to the work team; they have signed the permit's team briefing section. The controls in parts 3 to 6 of this permit are in place.

rows: Work complete; team and tools withdrawn; area left clean
Final fire watch check: no smouldering, hot spots or damage
Locks VRF 21, 22 and 23 removed; pump and valves returned to service; permit cancelled
